verses.arabicText: طه
verses.transliteration: Tta-h
verses.translation: Ṭâ-Hâ

verses.arabicText: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Mā anzalnā ʿalayka l-qur'āna litashqā
verses.translation: We have not revealed the Quran to you ˹O Prophet˺ to cause you distress

verses.arabicText: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةً لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Illā tadhkiratal-limay-yakhshā
verses.translation: but as a reminder to those in awe ˹of Allah˺

verses.arabicText: تَنزِيلًا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.transliteration: Tanzīlam-mimman khalaqa l-arḍa wal-samāwāti l-ʿulā
verses.translation: ˹It is˺ a revelation from the One Who created the earth and the high heavens—

verses.arabicText: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Ar-raḥmānu ʿalā l-ʿarshi is'tawā
verses.translation: the Most Compassionate, ˹Who is˺ established on the Throne

verses.arabicText: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Lahu mā fī s-samāwāti wamā fī l-arḍi wamā baynahumā wamā taḥta th-tharā
verses.translation: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth and whatever is in between and whatever is underground

verses.arabicText: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.transliteration: Wa-in tajhar bil-qawli fa-innahu yaʿlamu s-sira wa-akhfā
verses.translation: Whether you speak openly ˹or not˺, He certainly knows what is secret and what is even more hidden

verses.arabicText: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Al-lahu lā ilāha illā huwa lahu l-asmāu l-ḥus'nā
verses.translation: Allah—there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He has the Most Beautiful Names

verses.arabicText: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wahal atāka ḥadīthu mūsā
verses.translation: Has the story of Moses reached you ˹O Prophet˺

verses.arabicText: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًى
verses.transliteration: Idh raā nāran faqāla li-ahlihi um'kuthū innī ānastu nāral-laʿallī ātīkum min'hā biqabasin aw ajidu ʿalā n-nāri hudā
verses.translation: When he saw a fire, he said to his family, “Wait here, ˹for˺ I have spotted a fire. Perhaps I can bring you a torch from it, or find some guidance at the fire.”

verses.arabicText: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Falammā atāhā nūdiya yāmūsā
verses.translation: But when he approached it, he was called, “O Moses

verses.arabicText: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًى
verses.transliteration: Innī anā rabbuka fa-ikh'laʿ naʿlayka innaka bil-wādi l-muqadasi ṭuwā
verses.translation: It is truly I. I am your Lord! So take off your sandals, for you are in the sacred valley of Ṭuwa

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wa-anā ikh'tartuka fa-is'tamiʿ limā yūḥā
verses.translation: I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed

verses.arabicText: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.transliteration: Innanī anā l-lahu lā ilāha illā anā fa-uʿ'bud'nī wa-aqimi ṣ-ṣalata lidhik'rī
verses.translation: ‘It is truly I. I am Allah! There is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Me. So worship Me ˹alone˺, and establish prayer for My remembrance

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna s-sāʿata ātiyatun akādu ukh'fīhā lituj'zā kullu nafsin bimā tasʿā
verses.translation: The Hour is sure to come. My Will is to keep it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded according to their efforts

verses.arabicText: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Falā yaṣuddannaka ʿanhā mal-lā yu'minu bihā wa-ittabaʿa hawāhu fatardā
verses.translation: So do not let those who disbelieve in it and follow their desires distract you from it, or you will be doomed.’”

verses.arabicText: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wamā til'ka biyamīnika yāmūsā
verses.translation: ˹Allah added,˺ “And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla hiya ʿaṣāya atawakka-u ʿalayhā wa-ahushu bihā ʿalā ghanamī waliya fīhā maāribu ukh'rā
verses.translation: He replied, “It is my staff! I lean on it, and with it I beat down ˹branches˺ for my sheep, and have other uses for it.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla alqihā yāmūsā
verses.translation: Allah said, “Throw it down, O Moses!”

verses.arabicText: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fa-alqāhā fa-idhā hiya ḥayyatun tasʿā
verses.translation: So he did, then—behold!—it became a serpent, slithering

verses.arabicText: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla khudh'hā walā takhaf sanuʿīduhā sīratahā l-ūlā
verses.translation: Allah said, “Take it, and have no fear. We will return it to its former state

verses.arabicText: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wa-uḍ'mum yadaka ilā janāḥika takhruj bayḍāa min ghayri sūin āyatan ukh'rā
verses.translation: And put your hand under your armpit, it will come out ˹shining˺ white, unblemished, as another sign

verses.arabicText: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.transliteration: Linuriyaka min āyātinā l-kub'rā
verses.translation: so that We may show you some of Our greatest signs

verses.arabicText: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Idh'hab ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā
verses.translation: Go to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi ish'raḥ lī ṣadrī
verses.translation: Moses prayed, “My Lord! Uplift my heart for me

verses.arabicText: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.transliteration: Wayassir lī amrī
verses.translation: and make my task easy

verses.arabicText: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةً مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.transliteration: Wa-uḥ'lul ʿuq'datam-mil-lisānī
verses.translation: and remove the impediment from my tongue

verses.arabicText: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.transliteration: Yafqahū qawlī
verses.translation: so people may understand my speech

verses.arabicText: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.transliteration: Wa-ij'ʿal lī wazīram-min ahlī
verses.translation: and grant me a helper from my family

verses.arabicText: هَـٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.transliteration: Hārūna akhī
verses.translation: Aaron, my brother

verses.arabicText: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.transliteration: Ush'dud bihi azrī
verses.translation: Strengthen me through him

verses.arabicText: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.transliteration: Wa-ashrik'hu fī amrī
verses.translation: and let him share my task

verses.arabicText: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Kay nusabbiḥaka kathīrā
verses.translation: so that we may glorify You much

verses.arabicText: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Wanadhkuraka kathīrā
verses.translation: and remember You much

verses.arabicText: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Innaka kunta binā baṣīrā
verses.translation: for truly You have ˹always˺ been overseeing us.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla qad ūtīta su'laka yāmūsā
verses.translation: Allah responded, “All that you requested has been granted, O Moses

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad manannā ʿalayka marratan ukh'rā
verses.translation: And surely We had shown You favour before

verses.arabicText: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Idh awḥaynā ilā ummika mā yūḥā
verses.translation: when We inspired your mother with this

verses.arabicText: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةً مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.transliteration: Ani iq'dhifīhi fī t-tābūti fa-iq'dhifīhi fī l-yami falyul'qihi l-yamu bil-sāḥili yakhudh'hu ʿaduwwul-lī waʿaduwwul-lahu wa-alqaytu ʿalayka maḥabbatam-minnī walituṣ'naʿa ʿalā ʿaynī
verses.translation: ‘Put him into a chest, then put it into the river. The river will wash it ashore, and he will be taken by ˹Pharaoh,˺ an enemy of Mine and his.’ And I blessed you with lovability from Me ˹O Moses˺ so that you would be brought up under My ˹watchful˺ Eye

verses.arabicText: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَـٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًا فَنَجَّيْنَـٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّـٰكَ فُتُونًا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Idh tamshī ukh'tuka fataqūlu hal adullukum ʿalā may-yakfuluhu farajaʿnāka ilā ummika kay taqarra ʿaynuhā walā taḥzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynāka mina l-ghami wafatannāka futūnan falabith'ta sinīna fī ahli madyana thumma ji'ta ʿalā qadariy-yāmūsā
verses.translation: ˹Remember˺ when your sister came along and proposed, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will nurse him?’ So We reunited you with your mother so that her heart would be put at ease, and she would not grieve. ˹Later˺ you killed a man ˹by mistake˺, but We saved you from sorrow, as well as other tests We put you through. Then you stayed for a number of years among the people of Midian. Then you came here as pre-destined, O Moses

verses.arabicText: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.transliteration: Wa-iṣ'ṭanaʿtuka linafsī
verses.translation: And I have selected you for My service

verses.arabicText: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.transliteration: Idh'hab anta wa-akhūka biāyātī walā taniyā fī dhik'rī
verses.translation: Go forth, you and your brother, with My signs and never falter in remembering Me

verses.arabicText: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Idh'habā ilā fir'ʿawna innahu ṭaghā
verses.translation: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh, for he has truly transgressed ˹all bounds˺

verses.arabicText: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًا لَّيِّنًا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Faqūlā lahu qawlal-layyinal-laʿallahu yatadhakkaru aw yakhshā
verses.translation: Speak to him gently, so perhaps he may be mindful ˹of Me˺ or fearful ˹of My punishment˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qālā rabbanā innanā nakhāfu ay-yafruṭa ʿalaynā aw ay-yaṭghā
verses.translation: They both pleaded, “Our Lord! We fear that he may be quick to harm us or act tyrannically.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lā takhāfā innanī maʿakumā asmaʿu wa-arā
verses.translation: Allah reassured ˹them˺, “Have no fear! I am with you, hearing and seeing

verses.arabicText: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Fatiyāhu faqūlā innā rasūlā rabbika fa-arsil maʿanā banī is'rāīla walā tuʿadhib'hum qad ji'nāka biāyatim-mir-rabbika wal-salāmu ʿalā mani ittabaʿa l-hudā
verses.translation: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed we are both messengers from your Lord, so let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not oppress them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And salvation will be for whoever follows the ˹right˺ guidance

verses.arabicText: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Innā qad ūḥiya ilaynā anna l-ʿadhāba ʿalā man kadhaba watawallā
verses.translation: It has indeed been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies ˹the truth˺ and turns away.’”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla famar-rabbukumā yāmūsā
verses.translation: Pharaoh asked, “Who then is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbunā alladhī aʿṭā kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hadā
verses.translation: He answered, “Our Lord is the One Who has given everything its ˹distinctive˺ form, then guided ˹it˺.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla famā bālu l-qurūni l-ūlā
verses.translation: Pharaoh asked, “And what about previous peoples?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَـٰبٍ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.transliteration: Qāla ʿil'muhā ʿinda rabbī fī kitābil-lā yaḍillu rabbī walā yansā
verses.translation: He replied, “That knowledge is with my Lord in a Record. My Lord neither falters nor forgets ˹anything˺.”

verses.arabicText: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءً فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّن نَّبَاتٍ شَتَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Alladhī jaʿala lakumu l-arḍa mahdaw-wasalaka lakum fīhā subulaw-wa-anzala mina s-samāi māan fa-akhrajnā bihi azwājam-min-nabātin shattā
verses.translation: ˹He is the One˺ Who has laid out the earth for ˹all of˺ you, and set in it pathways for you, and sends down rain from the sky, causing various types of plants to grow

verses.arabicText: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَـٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Kulū wa-ir'ʿaw anʿāmakum inna fī dhālika laāyātil-li-ulī n-nuhā
verses.translation: ˹so˺ eat and graze your cattle. Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment

verses.arabicText: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Min'hā khalaqnākum wafīhā nuʿīdukum wamin'hā nukh'rijukum tāratan ukh'rā
verses.translation: From the earth We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will bring you back again

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad araynāhu āyātinā kullahā fakadhaba wa-abā
verses.translation: And We certainly showed Pharaoh all of Our signs, but he denied them and refused ˹to believe˺

verses.arabicText: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla aji'tanā litukh'rijanā min arḍinā bisiḥ'rika yāmūsā
verses.translation: He said, “Have you come to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses

verses.arabicText: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًا سُوًى
verses.transliteration: Falanatiyannaka bisiḥ'rim-mith'lihi fa-ij'ʿal baynanā wabaynaka mawʿidal-lā nukh'lifuhu naḥnu walā anta makānan suwā
verses.translation: We can surely meet you with similar magic. So set for us an appointment that neither of us will fail to keep, in a central place.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًى
verses.transliteration: Qāla mawʿidukum yawmu z-zīnati wa-ay-yuḥ'shara n-nāsu ḍuḥā
verses.translation: Moses said, “Your appointment is on the Day of the Festival, and let the people be gathered mid-morning.”

verses.arabicText: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fatawallā fir'ʿawnu fajamaʿa kaydahu thumma atā
verses.translation: Pharaoh then withdrew, orchestrated his scheme, then returned

verses.arabicText: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla lahum mūsā waylakum lā taftarū ʿalā l-lahi kadhiban fayus'ḥitakum biʿadhābiw-waqad khāba mani if'tarā
verses.translation: Moses warned the magicians, “Woe to you! Do not fabricate a lie against Allah, or He will wipe you out with a torment. Whoever fabricates ˹lies˺ is bound to fail.”

verses.arabicText: فَتَنَـٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fatanāzaʿū amrahum baynahum wa-asarrū n-najwā
verses.translation: So the magicians disputed the matter among themselves, conversing privately

verses.arabicText: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَٰنِ لَسَـٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qālū in hādhāni lasāḥirāni yurīdāni ay-yukh'rijākum min arḍikum bisiḥ'rihimā wayadhhabā biṭarīqatikumu l-muth'lā
verses.translation: They concluded, “These two are only magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic, and do away with your most cherished traditions

verses.arabicText: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ajmiʿū kaydakum thumma i'tū ṣaffaw-waqad aflaḥa l-yawma mani is'taʿlā
verses.translation: So orchestrate your plan, then come forward in ˹perfect˺ ranks. And whoever prevails today will certainly be successful.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qālū yāmūsā immā an tul'qiya wa-immā an-nakūna awwala man alqā
verses.translation: They said, “O Moses! Either you cast, or let us be the first to cast.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla bal alqū fa-idhā ḥibāluhum waʿiṣiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min siḥ'rihim annahā tasʿā
verses.translation: Moses responded, “No, you go first.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs appeared to him—by their magic—to be slithering

verses.arabicText: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةً مُّوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fa-awjasa fī nafsihi khīfatam-mūsā
verses.translation: So Moses concealed fear within himself

verses.arabicText: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qul'nā lā takhaf innaka anta l-aʿlā
verses.translation: We reassured ˹him˺, “Do not fear! It is certainly you who will prevail

verses.arabicText: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَـٰحِرٍ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wa-alqi mā fī yamīnika talqaf mā ṣanaʿū innamā ṣanaʿū kaydu sāḥiriw-walā yuf'liḥu s-sāḥiru ḥaythu atā
verses.translation: Cast what is in your right hand, and it will swallow up what they have made, for what they have made is no more than a magic trick. And magicians can never succeed wherever they go.”

verses.arabicText: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fa-ul'qiya s-saḥaratu sujjadan qālū āmannā birabbi hārūna wamūsā
verses.translation: So the magicians fell down in prostration, declaring, “We believe in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla āmantum lahu qabla an ādhana lakum innahu lakabīrukumu alladhī ʿallamakumu s-siḥ'ra fala-uqaṭṭiʿanna aydiyakum wa-arjulakum min khilāfiw-wala-uṣallibannakum fī judhūʿi n-nakhli walataʿlamunna ayyunā ashaddu ʿadhābaw-wa-abqā
verses.translation: Pharaoh threatened, “How dare you believe in him before I give you permission? He must be your master who taught you magic. I will certainly cut off your hands and feet on opposite sides, and crucify you on the trunks of palm trees. You will really see whose punishment is more severe and more lasting.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.transliteration: Qālū lan-nu'thiraka ʿalā mā jāanā mina l-bayināti wa-alladhī faṭaranā fa-iq'ḍi mā anta qāḍin innamā taqḍī hādhihi l-ḥayata d-dun'yā
verses.translation: They responded, “By the One Who created us! We will never prefer you over the clear proofs that have come to us. So do whatever you want! Your authority only covers the ˹fleeting˺ life of this world

verses.arabicText: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Innā āmannā birabbinā liyaghfira lanā khaṭāyānā wamā akrahtanā ʿalayhi mina s-siḥ'ri wal-lahu khayruw-wa-abqā
verses.translation: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord so He may forgive our sins and that magic you have forced us to practice. And Allah is far superior ˹in reward˺ and more lasting ˹in punishment˺.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Innahu may-yati rabbahu muj'riman fa-inna lahu jahannama lā yamūtu fīhā walā yaḥyā
verses.translation: Whoever comes to their Lord as an evildoer will certainly have Hell, where they can neither live nor die

verses.arabicText: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَـٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wamay-yatihi mu'minan qad ʿamila ṣ-ṣāliḥāti fa-ulāika lahumu d-darajātu l-ʿulā
verses.translation: But whoever comes to Him as a believer, having done good, they will have the highest ranks

verses.arabicText: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.transliteration: Jannātu ʿadnin tajrī min taḥtihā l-anhāru khālidīna fīhā wadhālika jazāu man tazakkā
verses.translation: the Gardens of Eternity, under which rivers flow, where they will stay forever. That is the reward of those who purify themselves

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walaqad awḥaynā ilā mūsā an asri biʿibādī fa-iḍ'rib lahum ṭarīqan fī l-baḥri yabasal-lā takhāfu darakaw-walā takhshā
verses.translation: And We surely inspired Moses, ˹saying,˺ “Leave with My servants ˹at night˺ and strike a dry passage for them across the sea. Have no fear of being overtaken, nor be concerned ˹of drowning˺.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.transliteration: Fa-atbaʿahum fir'ʿawnu bijunūdihi faghashiyahum mina l-yami mā ghashiyahum
verses.translation: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers—but how overwhelming were the waters that submerged them

verses.arabicText: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wa-aḍalla fir'ʿawnu qawmahu wamā hadā
verses.translation: And ˹so˺ Pharaoh led his people astray, and did not guide ˹them rightly˺

verses.arabicText: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَـٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Yābanī is'rāīla qad anjaynākum min ʿaduwwikum wawāʿadnākum jāniba ṭ-ṭūri l-aymana wanazzalnā ʿalaykumu l-mana wal-salwā
verses.translation: O Children of Israel! We saved you from your enemy, and made an appointment with you on the right side of Mount Ṭûr, and sent down to you manna and quails

verses.arabicText: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Kulū min ṭayyibāti mā razaqnākum walā taṭghaw fīhi fayaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabī wamay-yaḥlil ʿalayhi ghaḍabī faqad hawā
verses.translation: ˹saying,˺ “Eat from the good things We have provided for you, but do not transgress in them, or My wrath will befall you. And whoever My wrath befalls is certainly doomed

verses.arabicText: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wa-innī laghaffārul-liman tāba waāmana waʿamila ṣāliḥan thumma ih'tadā
verses.translation: But I am truly Most Forgiving to whoever repents, believes, and does good, then persists on ˹true˺ guidance.”

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wamā aʿjalaka ʿan qawmika yāmūsā
verses.translation: ˹Allah asked,˺ “Why have you come with such haste ahead of your people, O Moses?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla hum ulāi ʿalā atharī waʿajil'tu ilayka rabbi litarḍā
verses.translation: He replied, “They are close on my tracks. And I have hastened to You, my Lord, so You will be pleased.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-innā qad fatannā qawmaka min baʿdika wa-aḍallahumu s-sāmiriy
verses.translation: Allah responded, “We have indeed tested your people in your absence, and the Sâmiri has led them astray.”

verses.arabicText: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَـٰنَ أَسِفًا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
verses.transliteration: Farajaʿa mūsā ilā qawmihi ghaḍbāna asifan qāla yāqawmi alam yaʿid'kum rabbukum waʿdan ḥasanan afaṭāla ʿalaykumu l-ʿahdu am aradttum ay-yaḥilla ʿalaykum ghaḍabum-mir-rabbikum fa-akhlaftum mawʿidī
verses.translation: So Moses returned to his people, furious and sorrowful. He said, “O my people! Had your Lord not made you a good promise? Has my absence been too long for you? Or have you wished for wrath from your Lord to befall you, so you broke your promise to me?”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَـٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.transliteration: Qālū mā akhlafnā mawʿidaka bimalkinā walākinnā ḥummil'nā awzāram-min zīnati l-qawmi faqadhafnāhā fakadhālika alqā s-sāmiriy
verses.translation: They argued, “We did not break our promise to you of our own free will, but we were made to carry the burden of the people’s ˹golden˺ jewellery, then we threw it ˹into the fire˺, and so did the Sâmiri.”

verses.arabicText: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًا جَسَدًا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌ فَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akhraja lahum ʿij'lan jasadal-lahu khuwārun faqālū hādhā ilāhukum wa-ilāhu mūsā fanasiy
verses.translation: Then he moulded for them an idol of a calf that made a lowing sound. They said, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but Moses forgot ˹where it was˺!”

verses.arabicText: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّا وَلَا نَفْعًا
verses.transliteration: Afalā yarawna allā yarjiʿu ilayhim qawlaw-walā yamliku lahum ḍarraw-walā nafʿā
verses.translation: Did they not see that it did not respond to them, nor could it protect or benefit them

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَـٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
verses.transliteration: Walaqad qāla lahum hārūnu min qablu yāqawmi innamā futintum bihi wa-inna rabbakumu r-raḥmānu fa-ittabiʿūnī wa-aṭīʿū amrī
verses.translation: Aaron had already warned them beforehand, “O my people! You are only being tested by this, for indeed your ˹one true˺ Lord is the Most Compassionate. So follow me and obey my orders.”

verses.arabicText: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qālū lan-nabraḥa ʿalayhi ʿākifīna ḥattā yarjiʿa ilaynā mūsā
verses.translation: They replied, “We will not cease to worship it until Moses returns to us.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَـٰهَـٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
verses.transliteration: Qāla yāhārūnu mā manaʿaka idh ra-aytahum ḍallū
verses.translation: Moses scolded ˹his brother˺, “O Aaron! What prevented you, when you saw them going astray

verses.arabicText: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
verses.transliteration: Allā tattabiʿani afaʿaṣayta amrī
verses.translation: from following after me? How could you disobey my orders?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
verses.transliteration: Qāla yabna-umma lā takhudh biliḥ'yatī walā birasī innī khashītu an taqūla farraqta bayna banī is'rāīla walam tarqub qawlī
verses.translation: Aaron pleaded, “O son of my mother! Do not seize me by my beard or ˹the hair of˺ my head. I really feared that you would say, ‘You have caused division among the Children of Israel, and did not observe my word.’”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَـٰسَـٰمِرِىُّ
verses.transliteration: Qāla famā khaṭbuka yāsāmiriyy
verses.translation: Moses then asked, “What did you think you were doing, O Sâmiri?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةً مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
verses.transliteration: Qāla baṣur'tu bimā lam yabṣurū bihi faqabaḍtu qabḍatam-min athari r-rasūli fanabadhtuhā wakadhālika sawwalat lī nafsī
verses.translation: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful ˹of dust˺ from the hoof-prints of ˹the horse of˺ the messenger-angel ˹Gabriel˺ then cast it ˹on the moulded calf˺. This is what my lower-self tempted me into.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verses.transliteration: Qāla fa-idh'hab fa-inna laka fī l-ḥayati an taqūla lā misāsa wa-inna laka mawʿidal-lan tukh'lafahu wa-unẓur ilā ilāhika alladhī ẓalta ʿalayhi ʿākifal-lanuḥarriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fī l-yami nasfā
verses.translation: Moses said, “Go away then! And for ˹the rest of your˺ life you will surely be crying, ‘Do not touch ˹me˺!’ Then you will certainly have a fate that you cannot escape. Now look at your god to which you have been devoted: we will burn it up, then scatter it in the sea completely.”

verses.arabicText: إِنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًا
verses.transliteration: Innamā ilāhukumu l-lahu alladhī lā ilāha illā huwa wasiʿa kulla shayin ʿil'mā
verses.translation: ˹Then Moses addressed his people,˺ “Your only god is Allah, there is no god ˹worthy of worship˺ except Him. He encompasses everything in ˹His˺ knowledge.”

verses.arabicText: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًا
verses.transliteration: Kadhālika naquṣṣu ʿalayka min anbāi mā qad sabaqa waqad ātaynāka mil-ladunnā dhik'rā
verses.translation: This is how We relate to you ˹O Prophet˺ some of the stories of the past. And We have certainly granted you a Reminder from Us

verses.arabicText: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
verses.transliteration: Man aʿraḍa ʿanhu fa-innahu yaḥmilu yawma l-qiyāmati wiz'rā
verses.translation: Whoever turns away from it will surely bear the burden ˹of sin˺ on the Day of Judgment

verses.arabicText: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ حِمْلًا
verses.transliteration: Khālidīna fīhi wasāa lahum yawma l-qiyāmati ḥim'lā
verses.translation: suffering its consequences forever. What an evil burden they will carry on Judgment Day

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍ زُرْقًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma yunfakhu fī ṣ-ṣūri wanaḥshuru l-muj'rimīna yawma-idhin zur'qā
verses.translation: ˹Beware of˺ the Day the Trumpet will be blown, and We will gather the wicked on that Day blue-faced ˹from horror and thirst˺

verses.arabicText: يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًا
verses.transliteration: Yatakhāfatūna baynahum il-labith'tum illā ʿashrā
verses.translation: They will whisper among themselves, “You stayed no more than ten days ˹on the earth˺.”

verses.arabicText: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًا
verses.transliteration: Naḥnu aʿlamu bimā yaqūlūna idh yaqūlu amthaluhum ṭarīqatan il-labith'tum illā yawmā
verses.translation: We know best what they will say—the most reasonable of them will say, “You stayed no more than a day.”

verses.arabicText: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًا
verses.transliteration: Wayasalūnaka ʿani l-jibāli faqul yansifuhā rabbī nasfā
verses.translation: And ˹if˺ they ask you ˹O Prophet˺ about the mountains, ˹then˺ say, “My Lord will wipe them out completely

verses.arabicText: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًا صَفْصَفًا
verses.transliteration: Fayadharuhā qāʿan ṣafṣafā
verses.translation: leaving the earth level and bare

verses.arabicText: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًا وَلَآ أَمْتًا
verses.transliteration: Lā tarā fīhā ʿiwajaw-walā amtā
verses.translation: with neither depressions nor elevations to be seen.”

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَئِذٍ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma-idhiy-yattabiʿūna d-dāʿiya lā ʿiwaja lahu wakhashaʿati l-aṣwātu lilrraḥmāni falā tasmaʿu illā hamsā
verses.translation: On that Day all will follow the caller ˹for assembly˺, ˹and˺ none will dare to deviate. All voices will be hushed before the Most Compassionate. Only whispers will be heard

verses.arabicText: يَوْمَئِذٍ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًا
verses.transliteration: Yawma-idhil-lā tanfaʿu sh-shafāʿatu illā man adhina lahu r-raḥmānu waraḍiya lahu qawlā
verses.translation: On that Day no intercession will be of any benefit, except by those granted permission by the Most Compassionate and whose words are agreeable to Him

verses.arabicText: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًا
verses.transliteration: Yaʿlamu mā bayna aydīhim wamā khalfahum walā yuḥīṭūna bihi ʿil'mā
verses.translation: He ˹fully˺ knows what is ahead of them and what is behind them, but they cannot encompass Him in ˹their˺ knowledge

verses.arabicText: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًا
verses.transliteration: Waʿanati l-wujūhu lil'ḥayyi l-qayūmi waqad khāba man ḥamala ẓul'mā
verses.translation: And all faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, All-Sustaining. And those burdened with wrongdoing will be in loss

verses.arabicText: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًا وَلَا هَضْمًا
verses.transliteration: Wamay-yaʿmal mina ṣ-ṣāliḥāti wahuwa mu'minun falā yakhāfu ẓul'maw-walā haḍmā
verses.translation: But whoever does good and is a believer will have no fear of being wronged or denied ˹their reward˺

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًا
verses.transliteration: Wakadhālika anzalnāhu qur'ānan ʿarabiyyaw-waṣarrafnā fīhi mina l-waʿīdi laʿallahum yattaqūna aw yuḥ'dithu lahum dhik'rā
verses.translation: And so We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran and varied the warnings in it, so perhaps they will shun evil or it may cause them to be mindful

verses.arabicText: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًا
verses.transliteration: Fataʿālā l-lahu l-maliku l-ḥaqu walā taʿjal bil-qur'āni min qabli ay-yuq'ḍā ilayka waḥyuhu waqul rabbi zid'nī ʿil'mā
verses.translation: Exalted is Allah, the True King! Do not rush to recite ˹a revelation of˺ the Quran ˹O Prophet˺ before it is ˹properly˺ conveyed to you, and pray, “My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.”

verses.arabicText: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًا
verses.transliteration: Walaqad ʿahid'nā ilā ādama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu ʿazmā
verses.translation: And indeed, We once made a covenant with Adam, but he forgot, and ˹so˺ We did not find determination in him

verses.arabicText: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wa-idh qul'nā lil'malāikati us'judū liādama fasajadū illā ib'līsa abā
verses.translation: And ˹remember˺ when We said to the angels, “Prostrate before Adam,” so they all did—but not Iblîs, who refused ˹arrogantly˺

verses.arabicText: فَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Faqul'nā yāādamu inna hādhā ʿaduwwul-laka walizawjika falā yukh'rijannakumā mina l-janati fatashqā
verses.translation: So We cautioned, “O Adam! This is surely an enemy to you and to your wife. So do not let him drive you both out of Paradise, for you ˹O Adam˺ would then suffer ˹hardship˺

verses.arabicText: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Inna laka allā tajūʿa fīhā walā taʿrā
verses.translation: Here it is guaranteed that you will never go hungry or unclothed

verses.arabicText: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wa-annaka lā taẓma-u fīhā walā taḍḥā
verses.translation: nor will you ˹ever˺ suffer from thirst or ˹the sun’s˺ heat.”

verses.arabicText: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fawaswasa ilayhi sh-shayṭānu qāla yāādamu hal adulluka ʿalā shajarati l-khul'di wamul'kil-lā yablā
verses.translation: But Satan whispered to him, saying, “O Adam! Shall I show you the Tree of Immortality and a kingdom that does not fade away?”

verses.arabicText: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fa-akalā min'hā fabadat lahumā sawātuhumā waṭafiqā yakhṣifāni ʿalayhimā miw-waraqi l-janati waʿaṣā ādamu rabbahu faghawā
verses.translation: So they both ate from the tree and then their nakedness was exposed to them, prompting them to cover themselves with leaves from Paradise. So Adam disobeyed his Lord, and ˹so˺ lost his way

verses.arabicText: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Thumma ij'tabāhu rabbuhu fatāba ʿalayhi wahadā
verses.translation: Then his Lord chose him ˹for His grace˺, accepted his repentance, and guided him ˹rightly˺

verses.arabicText: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla ih'biṭā min'hā jamīʿan baʿḍukum libaʿḍin ʿaduwwun fa-immā yatiyannakum minnī hudan famani ittabaʿa hudāya falā yaḍillu walā yashqā
verses.translation: Allah said, “Descend, both of you, from here together ˹with Satan˺ as enemies to each other. Then when guidance comes to you from Me, whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray ˹in this life˺ nor suffer ˹in the next˺

verses.arabicText: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةً ضَنكًا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waman aʿraḍa ʿan dhik'rī fa-inna lahu maʿīshatan ḍankaw-wanaḥshuruhu yawma l-qiyāmati aʿmā
verses.translation: But whoever turns away from My Reminder will certainly have a miserable life, then We will raise them up blind on the Day of Judgment.”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًا
verses.transliteration: Qāla rabbi lima ḥashartanī aʿmā waqad kuntu baṣīrā
verses.translation: They will cry, “My Lord! Why have you raised me up blind, although I used to see?”

verses.arabicText: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qāla kadhālika atatka āyātunā fanasītahā wakadhālika l-yawma tunsā
verses.translation: Allah will respond, “It is so, just as Our revelations came to you and you neglected them, so Today you are neglected.”

verses.arabicText: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.transliteration: Wakadhālika najzī man asrafa walam yu'min biāyāti rabbihi walaʿadhābu l-ākhirati ashaddu wa-abqā
verses.translation: This is how We reward whoever transgresses and does not believe in the revelations of their Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is far more severe and more lasting

verses.arabicText: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlaknā qablahum mina l-qurūni yamshūna fī masākinihim inna fī dhālika laāyātil-li-ulī n-nuhā
verses.translation: Is it not yet clear to them how many peoples We destroyed before them, whose ruins they still pass by? Surely in this are signs for people of sound judgment

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًا وَأَجَلٌ مُّسَمًّى
verses.transliteration: Walawlā kalimatun sabaqat mir-rabbika lakāna lizāmaw-wa-ajalum-musammā
verses.translation: Had it not been for a prior decree from your Lord ˹O Prophet˺ and a term already set, their ˹instant˺ doom would have been inevitable

verses.arabicText: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Fa-iṣ'bir ʿalā mā yaqūlūna wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika qabla ṭulūʿi sh-shamsi waqabla ghurūbihā wamin ānāi al-layli fasabbiḥ wa-aṭrāfa n-nahāri laʿallaka tarḍā
verses.translation: So be patient ˹O Prophet˺ with what they say. And glorify the praises of your Lord before sunrise and before sunset, and glorify Him in the hours of the night and at both ends of the day, so that you may be pleased ˹with the reward˺

verses.arabicText: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌ وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walā tamuddanna ʿaynayka ilā mā mattaʿnā bihi azwājam-min'hum zahrata l-ḥayati d-dun'yā linaftinahum fīhi wariz'qu rabbika khayruw-wa-abqā
verses.translation: Do not let your eyes crave what We have allowed some of the disbelievers to enjoy; the ˹fleeting˺ splendour of this worldly life, which We test them with. But your Lord’s provision ˹in the Hereafter˺ is far better and more lasting

verses.arabicText: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Wamur ahlaka bil-ṣalati wa-iṣ'ṭabir ʿalayhā lā nasaluka riz'qan-naḥnu narzuquka wal-ʿāqibatu lilttaqwā
verses.translation: Bid your people to pray, and be diligent in ˹observing˺ it. We do not ask you to provide. It is We Who provide for you. And the ultimate outcome is ˹only˺ for ˹the people of˺ righteousness

verses.arabicText: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Waqālū lawlā yatīnā biāyatim-mir-rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu mā fī ṣ-ṣuḥufi l-ūlā
verses.translation: They demand, “If only he could bring us a sign from his Lord!” Have they not ˹already˺ received a confirmation of what is in earlier Scriptures

verses.arabicText: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِعَذَابٍ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Walaw annā ahlaknāhum biʿadhābim-min qablihi laqālū rabbanā lawlā arsalta ilaynā rasūlan fanattabiʿa āyātika min qabli an-nadhilla wanakhzā
verses.translation: Had We destroyed them with a torment before this ˹Prophet came˺, they would have surely argued, “Our Lord! If only You had sent us a messenger, we would have followed Your revelations before being humiliated and put to shame.”

verses.arabicText: قُلْ كُلٌّ مُّتَرَبِّصٌ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.transliteration: Qul kullum-mutarabbiṣun fatarabbaṣū fasataʿlamūna man aṣḥābu ṣ-ṣirāṭi s-sawiyi wamani ih'tadā
verses.translation: Say ˹to them, O Prophet˺, “Each ˹of us˺ is waiting, so keep waiting! You will soon know who is on the Straight Path and is ˹rightly˺ guided.”
